k_means.name: K-Means
k_means.noise_handling: Forces all outliers into the nearest centroid
k_means.primary_use_case: Partitioning multi-state or statewide geography into administrative patrol zones

dbscan.name: DBSCAN
dbscan.distance_assumption: True Haversine spherical distance on Earth's surface
dbscan.cluster_geometry: Arbitrary geometric corridors following actual highway networks
dbscan.noise_handling: Separates isolated rural accidents as noise (19.85% nationwide)
dbscan.computational_speed: BallTree spatial indexing O(n log n)
dbscan.primary_use_case: Pinpointing genuine high-density accident corridors and urban blackspots
